“Dad you’re the best Dad”

Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Jamall Porter, is an American rapper, songwriter, and internet personality from Los Angeles, California. Born on January 20, 1997, Blueface rose to fame in 2018 with his breakout hit “Thotiana,” which became a viral sensation and eventually received a remix featuring Cardi B and YG. Known for his unconventional offbeat flow, distinctive voice, and West Coast sound, Blueface quickly became one of the most recognizable figures in the Los Angeles rap scene.

Following his success with “Thotiana,” Blueface continued building his music career with songs like “Bleed It,” “Daddy,” and “Respect My Cryppin’.” He collaborated with major artists, including Drake, Lil Baby, and Rich The Kid, while establishing himself as a prominent figure in West Coast hip-hop.

Outside of music, Blueface has remained a major topic on social media because of his personal life, relationships, and viral livestream moments. His highly publicized relationships with Jaidyn Alexis and Chrisean Rock have attracted significant attention over the years. Blueface shares two children, Javaughn and Journey, with Jaidyn Alexis and has also been involved in a widely discussed relationship with Nevaeh.

Despite facing legal troubles and controversies throughout his career, Blueface has maintained a strong online following. Since returning to the public spotlight following his incarceration, he has expanded his presence through livestreaming, viral content, and music while continuing to make headlines for his family life and relationships.
